inputs.helpDe: Below this threshold, artificial sealing is NOT required. At or above, Dichtungsmaßnahmen required.
Per DIN EN 12255-5; UV-beständiges Material bei Sonnenbestrahlung.
Mineralische Dichtung lagenweise auf ≥ 95% Proctordichte verdichten.

thresholds.messageEn: k_f — allgemeine Teiche: regulation value ≤ 1e-8 m/s (§5.8).
thresholds.iterationHint: Wirkung bei Verstoß: If FAILS (permeability is ≥ 10^{-8} m/s or soil is fractured): Artificial sealing is mandatory. Must install plastic sheets (≥ 3 mm and UV-resistant), concrete, asphalt, bentonite, or a ≥ 30 cm thick compacted clay/bentonite layer (≥ 95% Proctor density),. · Maßnahme: Iteration loop: If a soft artificial seal is required, the designer must check if desludging vehicles can still enter (or switch to floating pumps).
